failedCase.stack: Three r160 WebGLRenderer.compileAsync timer: properties.get(material).currentProgram.isReady() after action-scene disposal
failedCase.cause: Fast model→action→state navigation could dispose action materials/renderer while Three retained an uncancellable compilation timer.

differencesFromTarget: 保留现有蹲伏醒狮和网页LOD，姿态及绒毛几何与目标站立狮不同。

visualReview.missingMaterialsOrManualSteps: 本轮没有素材阻塞，也无需用户手工处理。

声音只核实媒体播放/muted及唯一主音轨，没有扬声器实听。
